meta.description:
Vietnam is a vibrant Southeast Asian country where natural beauty, rich history, and lively culture come together. From the stunning limestone islands of Ha Long Bay to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, every corner offers something unique. Bustling cities like Hanoi blend ancient traditions with modern life, while the country’s famous cuisine—like pho—adds unforgettable flavor to the journey. Vietnam is a destination that captivates travellers with its charm, energy, and warmth.
